name: BACH_0319
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, clean image, and second-model agreement support this [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 98%, Benign 2% | Clearly separated |
| Conformal set | Normal only (α=0.1) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.98 / 16th percentile | Typical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 5, 11) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood; caption check failed [F4] · Weak
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 0, 1, 2) · context · Above 96% of reference images; sampled regions only [F7] · Measured
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 4, 6) · context · Descriptive only; AI spot check 8/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (regions 4, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Scored high; AI spot check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to match the classifier. Normal lobules unreliable; TILs weak.

## Could be wrong if
- Benign is the nearest alternative; BACH_0185 (92% similar) is labeled Benign.
- Calibration is imprecise on a small test set (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2**: confirm dense immune cells are reactive, not obscuring epithelium.
2. **Regions 4, 7, 9**: inspect lobular architecture directly; its concept spot check was 0/20.
3. **Regions 0, 5, 11**: confirm gland formation is benign.
